resolved_findings.original_review_text: Concrete transport blocker under the Phase 2.5 strict remote-command boundary: .aris/m120_native_grid_20261007/deploy_m120.py:20 and inspect_native_interface.py:9 instantiate SSHClient + AutoAddPolicy without loading or checking trusted host keys, then submit the root password (lines 21-22 / 10-11). This accepts any presented SSH host identity before password authentication. Use the existing trusted known-host entry for the authorized endpoint (RejectPolicy/default rejection), or an independently established pinned host key; do not fetch a new key and call that verification.
resolved_findings.resolution: Executor replaced AutoAddPolicy with existing known_hosts loading and default RejectPolicy in both helpers and the new observer. Reviewer reread final code and verified the existing endpoint entry locally. Original executed read helper remains separately preserved; its earlier read is not retroactively described as host-verified. Secure deploy rechecks all six files before launch.

resolved_findings.original_review_text: One concrete collector contract gap remains: collect_m120_native_grids.py:89-116 never saves event resize_factor or initial resize although PLAN:16 explicitly requires prior/crop origin/resize; factor is only compared at line 106 then discarded. Minimal fix: append the actual event factor and store actual initial resize (prefer float64/Python float so this is the native geometry, not the M90 float32 comparison view). Also line 111 stores only float32 prior; keep the existing float32 M90 equality check, but save the original native before values as float64 if the stated exact-prior contract is intended. Actual rounded crop_origin currently is computed correctly from full-precision before.
resolved_findings.resolution: Executor added float64 event resize_factor, float64 native prior_bbox and initial_resize_factor=float(resize). Existing M90 float32 equality checks and actual rounded crop-origin calculation were retained; final source reread and parsed.

correctness_checks: Actual fetched native model lines 149-160 expose post-TSG RGB/depth and post-Mamba fused search tensors; collector takes these tensors directly, with 256 positions and driver-enforced 768 channels. Fused means the native returned pre-decode_fuse_search representation, as defined by that interface.

Auxiliary t0 forward passes track_query_before=None. The native model creates a local query list and its returned query is not submitted to tracker state. Collector asserts frame_id=0, state=init_box and tracker query remains None, then validates every subsequent native prefix bbox/score. Native track() continues its normal bbox/query/template updates.

M95 t0 search RoIs and M90 candidate boxes/RoIs are compared exactly at their original half/float32 cache precision. Prior/resize comparisons retain the M90 float32 contract; newly saved native prior and resize are float64, initial resize is a Python float, and rounded crop origin is computed from the unrounded native prior.

Padding coverage pools the actual sample_target resized boolean padding mask into the 16x16 grid. It denotes unpadded native crop pixels, not target visibility, identity truth, or valid-depth fraction. crop_geometry matches fetched sample_target ceil/round coordinates.

All network state_dict tensors are cloned before inference and checked for exact equality after collection; eval mode, requires_grad_(False), and no_grad are used. No optimizer, training entry point, GT labels, text bank, alternative bbox commit, new checkpoint, model download, installation, or retry is present.

Both fixed-GPU 3-event sanities must exit 0 and meet result checks before either full producer launches. Full totals are checked as 152 sequences, 3502 events and 219194 tracked prefix frames; the 152 legal t0 auxiliary reads are additional. Two sanity files and 152 full files are expected, not claimed produced.

Completed M90/M95/M98 receipts have matching preparation/checkpoint identities. M98 all-152 original-feature links match M90, and sequence/split/event/frame records agree in both shards; 130 fit and 22 development sequences remain fixed.

The existing known_hosts entry for the authorized 43811 endpoint was found locally with ssh-ed25519 type. All current private helpers load that file and keep default rejection of unknown/changed keys; no new key was fetched. Deployer verifies review sources, existing dependencies and all six native files before upload/launch, prechecks M119 completion, both idle GPUs and free space >8 GiB.

Deployer records first sanity at 180 seconds, first full observation at 3600 seconds, and a 6300-7200 second estimate. observe_once waits until its explicit deadline then performs one read-only snapshot of the original controller/nonbinary files; it does not retry, restart, install, download PT tensors, or mutate the remote experiment.
permanent_human_input_protocol: Future main training/formal inference uses the final manually reviewed CSV categories and stable attributes. Sequence names are checking cues only; unknown values remain empty. This explicitly authorized native-only visual-input collector neither reads text nor changes that protocol.
limitations: No M120 deployment, SSH connection, Torch import, GPU/model forward or install was performed by the reviewer. Runtime equality, finite tensors, frozen state, both sanity gates and full completion remain unaccepted until actual producer receipts.
Float16 grid storage is intentional. RoI exact checks use native tensors before grid quantization; re-sampling saved half grids is not asserted to be bitwise equal to old RoI caches.

Observer controller_alive is a /proc PID-existence observation, not independent proof of a running/non-zombie process or scientific completion. Completion requires driver.exit=0 and the complete-pair result; logs and child exits must be inspected on failure.

The six fetched native files are hashed actual local readback evidence from 2026-10-07T09:40:35+08:00; imported native implementation beyond those files is not independently backend-attested by this source review. Existing exact replay/RoI checks remain mandatory.
